entities.summary: Quinn Marcus Johnson is an American former professional football player who was a fullback in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the LSU Tigers and was selected by the Green Bay Packers in the fifth round of the 2009 NFL draft. Johnson was a part of the Packers' Super Bowl XLV championship team. He also played for the Tennessee Titans and Denver Broncos.
